target.title: fix(memory-core): unify QMD multi-collection search, add phase timings, fix archived-session identity loss
target.body:
## Summary

Implements Deliverables A and B of a memory-recall latency/correctness investigation (internal scope doc, workboard card ff37a4e4):

- **Unified multi-collection QMD search.** `QmdCommandClient.searchAcrossCollections` now issues exactly one `mcporter call` process for a multi-collection query when the server advertises the v2 unified `query` tool, instead of one process per collection. Measured baseline: a `corpus=all` search that previously spawned 3-4 sequential mcporter processes (~8.2s) collapses to one call. The v1 fallback (server has no `query` tool) and an explicit tool override both still spawn one process per collection, byte-for-byte unchanged. If the unified attempt itself fails for a non-tool-version reason (timeout, transient server error), it falls back once to a per-collection "degraded" mode and reports exactly which collections succeeded/failed via a new `callPlan` field (`mode: "unified" | "per-collection" | "degraded"`).
- **Phase timing instrumentation.** `QmdMemoryManager.search()` now reports per-phase wall-clock timings (dirty-sync wait, pending-update wait, collection query, result resolution) and a `hitsDroppedAtDocResolution` counter through the existing `onDebug` payload. Purely additive — no caller-facing schema change.
- **Archived-session identity-resolution fix.** Diagnosed against a live QMD index: an archived session's exported artifact name embeds a raw ISO timestamp (dots/colons), but QMD's own indexer normalizes `.`/`:` to `-` in a document's stem when recording its path in the `documents` table. The mapping table stored the raw name, so `refreshQmdSessionArtifactDocIds()`'s join on `(collection, path)` could never backfill a docid for an archived session, and every archived-session hit silently failed identity resolution instead of being visibility-checked. This mirrors the existing `restoreQmdNormalizedArchiveName()` reversal (read side) with the missing write-side counterpart. Only the stored mapping value is normalized; the on-disk exported filename is untouched. No privacy/visibility predicate changes.

## Test plan

- [x] `qmd-command-client.test.ts` (new): unified single-process call, v1 fallback preserved, degraded-mode partial failure, all-collections-failed error, explicit tool override unaffected
- [x] `qmd-session-exporter.test.ts`: archived session gets a normalized artifact/search path; live session is untouched
- [x] Full `extensions/memory-core` suite: 69 files / 1005 tests pass
- [x] Rebased clean onto current `main`
